summary.text: Natasha Baker is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 22 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Ronnie Alting (R).
A high school teacher, she named public education and childcare as her first priority in a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Natasha Baker graduated from William Henry Harrison High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Purdue University in 2013 and a graduate degree from Purdue University Global in 2021, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a high school teacher.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Baker said she was born and raised in the district, is a first-generation college graduate, and has been a Carroll County public educator for 12 years.
She said she is raising two children with her husband and described herself as not being a career politician.
She said her first priority is standing up for public education and childcare, and she also said she supports the separation of church and state.
